name: linktalk
description: LinkTalk — a multi-device live translation app. One phone hosts a room; others join by QR code, link, or face-to-face share (AirDrop / Nearby Share / NFC). Everyone speaks their own language and reads everyone else's in their own.

scripts.mobile:add:ios: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap add ios && npm run mobile:patch
scripts.mobile:add:android: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap add android && npm run mobile:patch
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap sync && npm run mobile:patch
